# Proxy d3d11.dll. Installed into the game folder as d3d11.dll by the app.
# Export stubs are generated by tools/gen_exports.sh from d3d11_exports.txt.
add_library(tessera_d3d11 SHARED
  dllmain.cpp
  proxy.cpp
  hooks.cpp
  vtable.cpp
  session.cpp
  log.cpp
  config.cpp
  module.cpp
  process.cpp
  pacing.cpp
  memory.cpp
  flip.cpp
  shaders.cpp
  workset.cpp
  exports_d3d11.asm
  exports_d3d11.def)

target_include_directories(tessera_d3d11 PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
# No C++ exceptions, no RTTI in the layer. Never link d3d11.lib: we are d3d11.
target_compile_definitions(tessera_d3d11 PRIVATE _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0)
target_compile_options(tessera_d3d11 PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/EHs-c- /GR- /Zi>)
target_link_options(tessera_d3d11 PRIVATE /DEBUG /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF)
# winmm: timeBeginPeriod (P5). Only system libraries.
target_link_libraries(tessera_d3d11 PRIVATE winmm)
